question: Which already registered source results actually instantiate each term in the PAH-OMC-020 K_(n,m) and D_n budget, with the required quantifiers and common-space authority?

fixed_scope.model: Exactly immutable PAH-001, original directed rates, labelled Gibbs state and OMC-004 strip.
fixed_scope.order: j tends to infinity at fixed n first, followed by the declared anchored n exhaustion; no diagonal or reversed order.
fixed_scope.target: R-512 minimal closed-form semigroup is a named target only until process/form identification is supplied.

fixed_scope.comparison: Use only the symbols J_(n,j), K_(n,m), D_n and the comparison required by the frozen PAH-OMC-020 contract; do not construct a new map or process.

J_fixed_n.meaning: Compact-time stationary finite-j error at fixed n.

K_state.meaning: State-passage contribution in the anchored comparison.

K_boundary.meaning: Outside-root boundary contribution in the anchored comparison.

K_uniform.meaning: One nonnegative K_(n,m) satisfying lim_(m->infinity) limsup_(n->infinity) K_(n,m)=0.
required: all previous K terms in one common comparison

D_target.meaning: Anchored finite correlation versus the semigroup selected by the R-512 minimal form.
